notes:
CRM notes / call snippets:
- Use case: clinical triage + support chat for patients; must preserve PHI (HIPAA).
- Workload shape: steady daytime traffic ~25 concurrent active chats (avg response 120-180 tokens), peak events (safety alerts, outage) expected up to 4x baseline for short bursts.
- Baseline sizing target derived in workshop: baseline QPS ~12 req/s (back-to-back user messages), avg output 150 tokens -> baseline token/sec ~1800. Peak planning: design for 5k tokens/sec sustained for 5-10m windows, with option to burst to 12k tokens/sec for <60s.
- Latency SLO ask: 95th < 300ms for short-turn chat completions (<256 tokens); legal pushing for 95th < 200ms in SLA negotiations for premium flows.
- Throughput guarantee ask: reserved pool must support 3x steady-state headroom and predictable token/sec per GPU (customer expects documentation for tokens/sec/GPU under our quantized config).
- Routing/fallback: primary in private VPC (on-prem gateway), fallback to dedicated hosted region (same jurisdiction) if capacity constrained; must preserve no-PHI egress rules.
- Observability: require per-route token cost, per-token latency histograms, trace links, and audit log exports to their SIEM (Splunk).
- Quantization: customer willing to adopt int8-q4 if Redwood can certify QPS/latency tradeoffs and eval metrics (ROUGE, clinical accuracy) pre-POC.
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit annual reserved capacity if SLA and burst policy clear.
- Quote from Dir. Engineering: "We need guarantees we can plan on — predictable tokens/sec and clear fallbacks; otherwise we'll engineer more complex buffering in front of the model."
- Artifacts referenced: drive deck (pricing + perf), security FAQ link, sample traces (GCS), and Fireflies transcript (ff_20260214_medora_poc_kickoff).
- Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize for batching/kv-cache recommendations, dedicated reserve for primary traffic, Private deployment for full isolation.

Customer requested a token/sec/GPU report and explicit burst policy.
